visual.general_description: Axial fused PET-CT image of the upper abdomen with color-coded uptake and one round intense focus in the liver.
visual.detailed_description: Axial color-coded image on a dark background: a grayscale anatomic image of the upper abdomen (body outline, ribs, a vertebral body at the bottom center with the spinal canal behind it) overlaid with a blue-green-yellow-red color scale. The large liver fills the image-left and central part and shows mottled green uptake with scattered yellow spots. In the liver on the image-left side there is one round focus with a red-magenta center and a yellow rim, clearly brighter than the surrounding liver. A smaller yellow-orange focus lies to the image-right of the midline in the upper abdomen, adjacent to a ring-shaped structure with a gas-like dark center, and mottled yellow uptake is seen in the structure at the far image-right. No arrows, panel letters, text, scale bar, color bar or SUV values are printed on the image.
